verdict.rationale: Bruno's marketing emphasizes an offline-first, no-account, no-cloud-sync design with 'zero visibility into your requests' and no AI training on user data, implying no telemetry on API usage by design (bruno-docs-8, bruno-docs-48, bruno-docs-9). However, there is no explicit documentation of a telemetry/analytics toggle or opt-out setting for app-level usage tracking (e.g., crash reporting, feature analytics), so the claim is inferred from architecture rather than an explicit privacy control. missing for 10: explicit telemetry/analytics opt-out setting or documentation, independent verification of no background usage tracking.
